translation: Min ye muso sɔrɔ, o min ye ← a fɔra i n'a fɔ "yo min ye muso sɔrɔ, ye dɔɔnin sɔrɔ, ani a bɛ Yawe fɛ ka a bɔ Yawe la ko ya fɛ a kan"

tokens.gloss: (Min) ye ... sɔrɔ — i n'a fɔ a fɔcogo kɔrɔ: min bɛ taamarabaw la (matsa = o min y'a sɔrɔ, a bɛ jira min na) ni a fɛ
fɛn min fɛ (a bɔli) — y'a ko ko a fɛ
